svg.title: Blast, the cursed evolution
svg.desc: The Blast arc. It opens at the Ogremon hunt, where Igor's DV Plug sets it off at once, and the first Blast is blessed. 1: fill the gauge with risky offence: WEAK +150, a staggered target +100, an extra action +100, OVERFINISH +200, summed per blow; an item or a try to run takes 100. 2: at 1000, Blast with R2. 3: the partner takes one of its five dark forms, opened at levels 1, 10, 25, 35 and 40. 4: the price: HP and MP at 1 after the battle, -25% Power, Guard and Speed until an inn, and an overheat that keeps it in Rookie, unable to digivolve, for 3 of its turns, into the next battles. 5: release ten dark forms and "Gennai" has a word for you: a familiar face, or is it? Purify them all for your TP back and +10% of each form's best stat. 6: the Chosen Evolution: no curse, one partner, its Mega: GuardiAngemon, Beelzemon, Cannondramon, WarGreymon, Imperialdramon, Gallantmon, Sakuyamon or Seraphimon.
svg.text: Your partner's dark side, earned by fighting aggressively, then mastered.
Opens at the Ogremon hunt. Igor's gift, the DV Plug, sets it off at once; the first Blast is blessed: +50%, no TP.
